name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: A library of ready-made instructions that teaches any AI assistant how to correctly use 177 scientific tools and 100+ research databases, covering biology, chemistry, and medicine.
buyer: A biotech or pharma R&D lead who wants their scientists to get reliable AI help with lab data analysis without hiring a dedicated bioinformatics team.
business_use_cases: A contract research organization equips analysts' AI assistants with these skills so junior staff can run proper genomics and cheminformatics workflows without a PhD bioinformatician on every project.
A university core facility offers a self-service 'AI co-scientist' station, powered by this library, so grad students run standard assays and analyses faster.
A drug-discovery startup bundles these skills into its internal research-agent product to speed up virtual screening and ADMET analysis for clients.

money_ideas.idea: Sell the companion K-Dense BYOK desktop app, or a hosted/managed version with cloud compute for heavy workloads.
Offer paid training or certification for labs adopting 'AI scientist' workflows built on this skill set.

steal_this: Package a narrow slice, such as just the cheminformatics/ADMET skills, into a paid Slack or Claude bot for one specific biotech niche this weekend.
